newsitem.title: USA: Reebok International Q4 shr $0.35 vs $0.02.
newsitem.headline: Reebok International Q4 shr $0.35 vs $0.02.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
First Call Mean Estimate for Q2 was $0.34 per share.
First Call Mean Estimate for Year was $2.04

NOTES: Net sales includes revenues of the company's Avia subsidiary, which was sold in June 1996, amounting to $25.5 million in Q4 1995 and $129.6 million and $49.4 million in the years ended December 31, 1995 and 1996, respectively.

1995 amounts include a second quarter special charge of $11.2 million after taxes, or a charge of $0.14 per share, for facilities consolidation, severance and other expenses related to business re-engineering, as well as a fourth quarter special charge of $33.7 million after taxes, or a charge of $0.44 per share, for the writedown of the carrying value of Avia to estimated fair value on sale.
